# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified browser distribution from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/:

- `dist/leaflet.js`
- `dist/leaflet.css`
- `dist/images/*`
- `LICENSE`

Served locally so an unavailable third-party JavaScript CDN cannot prevent
the map from initializing. The map tiles still come from OpenStreetMap.
Keep the upstream license with the distribution when updating it.
